keywords_en: BPO1 live with blob target raised from 6 to 10
a restricted behavior transaction type EIP merged
the eth/vhash blob aware mempool EIP merged
the Tempo public testnet with native AA
Vitalik says PeerDAS proves EF's P2P strength
summary_en: BPO1 went live on mainnet, raising the blob target from 6 to 10, and 15 blob blocks appeared. forshtat's restricted behavior transaction type EIP merged. cskiraly's eth/vhash blob aware mempool EIP merged. gakonst launched the Tempo public testnet with multi validator BFT, native account abstraction and native stablecoin support.
